translation.name: Kitap molinas men ringkat na alaata'ala: perjanjian baru

content: Petrus tii Yohanes na aropna Mahkama Agama
Pintanga' morobu i Petrus tii Yohanes na mian biai', ola-olan taka a toro pii imam tia tanaasna dadagai Laiganna Alaata'ala ka' mian Saduki nomootuungi i Petrus tii Yohanes.
Raaya'a maso' gause i Petrus tii Yohanes nambantilkon na mian biai' se' i Yesus notuo'mo soosoodo ka' iya'a koi sa'angu' pinginti'ian se' mian lapus dauga' tumuo' soosoodo.
Mbaka' i raaya'a nangarakopmo rurua' poposuu' iya'a ka' nonsoopkon na tarungkuan. Gause malommo, Petrus tii Yohanes dauga' nitaankon na tarungkuan pataka koi liilana.
Kasee biai' a mian men nongorongor pisiso'na poposuu' iya'a nosida mian parasaya. Mbaka' saa'na i raaya'a nokanturanganmo; isian toro lima' loloon mian moro'one.
Koi liilana, mianna Mahkama Agama tonsoop tanaasna agama, tia motu-motu'a na samba Yahudi ka' wawa ukum Torat nopootuu'imo na Yerusalem bo pootundunii.
Raaya'a nomae'mo ni Hanas, Imam Moola', ka' i Kayafas, Yohanes, Aleksander ka' tia giigii' mian sambana men tonsoop poto'utusanna Imam Moola'.
Kasi i Petrus tii Yohanes niwawa na ko'ona i raaya'a kasi nipikirawari taena, “Koi upa mbali' daa kuu poko a nengelesi'i mian repo' kaya'a, kabai se' nimpu'u ni ime i kuu nangawawau men koiya'a?”
Petrus ia barios Alus Molinas ninsimbati taena, “Tuan tanaasna lipu' tia tuan mianna Mahkama!
Ilio kani'i, kai ni'ukumi gause nangawawau upa pore nuntulung sa'angu' mian repo' ka' gause ari tuan mo'uus minginti'i koi upa a mian iya'a nilesi'i.

Mbaka' kada' bo inti'ionmuu tuan ka' giigii' samba Israel, mbali' daa mian kani'i kere-kerer nalesi'mo koi men kuu piile' koini'i, mase kuasa ni Yesus Kristus samba Nazaret iya'a. Yesus iya'a kuu saliipkonmo, kasee Alaata'ala nomotuo'imo i Ia noko daa lapus.
Yesusmo kani'i a men nitulis na Alkitaap,

content.text: ‘Watu men kuu balo'konmo tukang, poali nosidamo watu tuko men bo pandasi.’

content: Sianta sa'angu'po mian men sida mansalamatkon saliwakon i Yesus. Gause giigii' mian na longkop tano' balaki', sianta mian sambana men ia pokau Alaata'ala bo pansalamatkon i kita.”

Mianna Mahkama iya'a samba' nimiile' kabaranian ni Petrus tii Yohanes gause ia inti'i i raaya'a, rua' ira iya'a tongko' mian biasa, sianta nosikola alayo'. Kasi ia too'inau' i raaya'a se' rurua' mian iya'a samba-samba ni Yesus.
Raaya'a sianmo norobu upa-upa gause mian men nilesi'i iya'a mondo'o kere-kerer na aropna i raaya'a tii Petrus ka' i Yohanes.
Mbaka' ia posuu'mo i raaya'a i Petrus tii Yohanes umuar, mamarerei tampat Pungukumian, kasi i raaya'a noposangadai.
Taena, “Upaiontamo a mian karaaya'a? Wiwi'na mian na Yerusalem ninginti'imo se' wawau men kosamba' tuu' iya'a ia wawau i raaya'a rua' ira. Sian sidaonta pokosianon.
Kasee kada' wawau iya'a sian tolele na mian biai', mbaka' i raaya'a rua' ira tiodaa arasonta kada' sianmo sida batundun na mian mangaan ngaan ni Yesus.”
Mbaka' rurua' poposuu' iya'a nileelo'mo minsoop soosoodo, kasi nirorongi se' sianmo sida batundun kabai mimisiso' mangaan ngaan ni Yesus.
Kasee ia simbati i Petrus tii Yohanes taena, “Intoomkon pore-pore a men daa kokana'na Alaata'ala: mongololoikon po'uus nari tuan kabai mongololoikon po'uusna Alaata'ala.
Gause i kai sian sida mongkorokotkon upa a men kai piile'mo ka' upa a men kai rongormo.”

Mbaka' rurua' poposuu' iya'a ia arasmo mianna Mahkama soosoodo ka' niposuu' mule'kon, gause i raaya'a sian nantausi salan bo pungukum i Petrus tii Yohanes men sian paraa mantakakon kogora'an na mian biai' men muntunde' Alaata'ala.
Mian men nilesi'i tia wawau kosamba' iya'a labimo patompulo' taun a umurna.
Petrus tii Yohanes moki popomoonggor kaparasaya'an na Alaata'ala
Sarataa i Petrus tii Yohanes nipatalai nomae', raaya'a nomule'konmo na samba-sambana ka' nuntundunkon wiwi'na upa men ia bantilkon tanaasna imam tia moomoola'na samba Yahudi na ko'ona i raaya'a.
Sarataa samba-sambana nongorongor koiya'a, raaya'a nosa'angu'mo noa ka' nosambayang na Alaata'ala taena, “Tumpu, Kuu a men nangawawau langit ka' tano' balaki' ka' tobui tia giigii' isiina.
Alus-Muu men Molinas a ninsidakon mian-Muu men i Daud pulimai nuntundunkon wurung-Muu men taena,

content.text: ‘Nongko'upa se' maso' a mian biai' men sian parasaya na Alaata'ala?
Nongko'upa se' biai' a lipu' sambana mangawawau sagia men sianta kana'na?
Tomundo' na tano' balaki' batoropot batumburi,
ka' tanaas basangada mintimban Tumpu tia Tomundo' Pansalamatkon.’

content: Gause i Herodes tii Pontius Pilatus tuutuu' nopoosangadaimo tia lipu' sambana ka' samba Israel na kota kani'i. Raaya'a nosangadamo mongkokundai i Yesus, mian-Muu men Molinas men Kuu nakatmo sida Tomundo' Pansalamatkon.
Raaya'a poosangadai mongkokundai i Yesus koi men Kuu ngaanmo na olukonanpo men sabole bo sida, upa a men Kuu ngaanmo iya'a mimpu'u na kuasa ka' po'uus-Muu.
Koini'i Tumpu, piile'! Raaya'a mangaras i kai. Tarai i kai salan kada' i kai mian-Muu kani'i momoko mae' mengelelekon lele-Muu.
Kai miki tulung kada' mian manggeo sida malesi', ka' pipiile'kon a oosan tia upa kosamba' men sida tia kuasa ni Yesus, mian-Muu men Molinas iya'a.”
Noko daa i raaya'a nosambayang, laigan men nopootatakaianna notoyunggotmo. Raaya'a wiwi'na ia lingkuduimo Alus Molinas ka' nomokomo nambantilkon lelena Alaata'ala.
Poowawana jama'at nosa'angu'mo noa

Tutuo'na giigii' mian men noparasayamo nosa'angu'mo noa ka' nosa'angu'mo pikiran. Sianta sa'angu'po mian men munsurikon se' upa men isian na ko'ona, tongko' i ia pontombonoi, kasee tombonoionna i raaya'a sanga-sangada.
Poposuu' iya'a isian kuasana Tumpu pataka i raaya'a nompotuutuu' se' i Yesus notuo'mo soosoodo, ka' balaki' tuu' a kaporeanna Alaata'ala na ko'ona i raaya'a.
Tutuo'na i raaya'a sa'angu'po sianta men marepa gause ime a men isian tano' kabai se' laigan, balukkononna ka' ilina wawaonna i raaya'a,
kasi rookonon na poposuu'. Raaya'asi a mongobo-oboskon na sanda' mian men mamaraluui.
Koiya'a uga' i Yusuf. Ia sa'angu' mian men lee' ni Lewi men ringkat na Siprus. Poposuu' nangaani ia i Barnabas (aratina Pantata'u).
Ia uga' nambalukkon tano'na, kasi ilina ia wawa ka' nirookon na poposuu'.
